Subject: FleetPilot SOW: egress restrictions and limited custodial audit - need confirmation

Hi Aisha / team,

Thanks for the productive demo last week. Two items popped up from our security and procurement review that are blocking procurement sign-off: 1) FleetPilot cannot permit any outbound egress from the private cluster to third-party storage outside our VPC; they require an absolute egress block except to a small set of vendor IPs; and 2) their legal ops is only willing to accept a 24-hour on-site custodial audit window (rather than the standard 30-day remote audit Redwood typically offers).

Attached is the SOW with redlines (FleetPilot_SOW_v3.pdf) and a short matrix of audit asks (FleetPilot_Audit_Reqs.xlsx). Can Redwood confirm whether we can:
- enforce a platform-level egress block for FleetPilot's dedicated private deployment;
- accept a time-boxed 24-hour on-site audit window limited to pre-approved runbooks and personnel; and
- provide a rollback/fallback plan in case the egress block causes an unexpected service regression during cutover?

Procurement needs answers by EOD Wednesday to keep the April quarter commit. Appreciate a quick run-down of technical and commercial implications (any upcharge or guardrail).

Thanks,
Alex Navarro
Head of Cloud Engineering, FleetPilot

---
Attachments: FleetPilot_SOW_v3.pdf, FleetPilot_Audit_Reqs.xlsx

Subject: Re: FleetPilot SOW: egress restrictions and limited custodial audit - need confirmation

Alex,

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments — reviewed quickly with infra and legal. Short answers up front:
- Egress-only: technically feasible to apply network policy that blocks all outbound traffic except to specified IPs/hosts; will require a dedicated private deployment configuration and a pre-cutover verification plan.
- 24-hour on-site audit: possible as an exception, but Legal flags this as higher risk to our standard controls; they'd like to scope and script the exact evidence and attendee list (we can't provide broad admin access).
- Rollback/fallback: we can provide a rehearsed rollback (automated route removal + KV cache TTL flush) that can be executed from our runbook within 30 minutes; but we should agree on RTO and who will trigger it.

I'm escalating to Deal Desk for an approval on concessions (timeboxed audit + egress carveout) and a commercial ask to cover operational overhead. Looping in Karthik and Lauren to confirm commercial + legal posture.

Best,
Aisha
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
